mostWorthwhile.text: Making new connective tissue was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects a collagen gene to messenger RNA, protein production and fibres that support the wound.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new surface felt predictable after the sheet had already been created; it was also the only offered combination.

surprise.text: The capillary sprout joined another vessel to form a local flow route, making the supply connection more concrete than simply adding a vessel.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final fitting steps were largely directed by the named slots and single compatible options rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: Yes, I would consider another chapter: the repair sequence connected familiar DNA-to-protein biology to a tangible outcome, although the repeated fitting steps were less engaging.
